title: Indicator vanishes on malformed queries
statement: Let $f$ map bit strings to bit strings, let $h$ be a bit string, and suppose $h$ is not the encoding of $(z,\operatorname{bin}(p))$ for any bit string $z$ and natural number $p$. For either Boolean choice of mode, the indicator of the language that contains encoded queries exactly when either $p$ is less than the transformed output length (in one mode) or the output bit at position $p$ is true (in the other mode) evaluates to false at $h$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from bit strings to bit strings
The mode is a Boolean value
For every bit string $z$ and natural number $p$, $h\ne\langle z,\operatorname{bin}(p)\rangle$
